title: Scenario 11: Hammering A Nail
systemText2:
Hammer on 
Earth Wooden 
Plank Nail
initialState2: A hammer was held vertically above a nail. It was about to fall to hit a nail into a wooden plank.
finalState2: The nail was embedded in the wooden plank. The hammer was stationary.
remarks2: A sound was produced when the hammer hits the nail. There was a slight increase in temperature in the hammer, nail and wooden plank. There was negligible transfer of energy to the surroundings by heating.
